Elena (PM): Short thread 7: need to lock MVP cut for observability console. Customers want fast error triage + clear cost panels.
Marcus (Eng): Can we ship error-slice + route-level cost tile in one sprint? Depends on aggregation work.
Zoe (SRE): Must include per-tenant sampling toggle and a 48h retention cap for traces in MVP to control storage.
Liam (Design): I'll prepare a dense operator layout: top row cost tiles, below error slices, right-side flyout for traces.
Ava (CS): Customer Z insists on CSV export for billing and model-version breakdown for their GA. Mark as required for them.
Elena (PM): Proposal: MVP = (1) cost-by-project 7/30d + CSV export, (2) error-slice panel with top signatures, (3) trace flyout linked from slice. Launch criteria: CSV ok, cost within 20% vs billing, trace flyout <300ms.
Marcus (Eng): Technical cut: drop high-cardinality user tags from MVP; include project & model-version only. That saves weeks.
Zoe (SRE): Canary plan: 10% customers -> 50% -> 100% with SLO checks. Auto-rollback if trace pipeline lag > 60s or cost-delta > 25%.
Elena (PM): Agree to the cut. Action items: Marcus -> rough sizing + aggregation plan (due Wed), Zoe -> canary automation + SLO list (Tue), Liam -> final mocks + microcopy (Tue), Ava -> confirm Customer Z CSV schema (Wed).
ops-bot: Feature flag obs-console-mvp created in staging (flag=obs-mvp-2026).
Marcus (Eng): Quick Q: should cost tooltip break down model vs infra? Customers asked for it but keep high-level.
Ava (CS): Keep it top-level in MVP, show breakdown in a follow-up.
Elena (PM): Thumbs if aligned.
Marcus (Eng): :+1:
Zoe (SRE): :thumbsup:
Liam (Design): :+1:
Ava (CS): :+1:
Elena (PM): Closing; follow-up sync Fri 9am.
